description: September 29 birthday meaning: Libra decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 29 birthday falls in Libra, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: The September 29 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Twenty-nine adds up to 11, a master number that numerologists keep whole and connect with intuition and inspiration. On September 29 it meets the Sun at about six degrees of Libra, in the Venus-ruled first decan. The interpretive result is an aesthete with antennae: someone who senses the mood of a room instantly and often expresses it through music, design or words.

Astronomically, September 29 puts the Sun near 6° Libra in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Libra's first decan, from about September 23 to October 2, holds Venus as both sign ruler and sub-ruler. This is traditionally the most graceful and relationship-minded part of the sign. Fairness, harmony and aesthetic sense are emphasised, along with a gift for making guests feel welcome. Those born here often weigh every side of a decision, which makes them good mediators and occasionally slow choosers. The doubled Venus influence can also lead to avoiding conflict at the cost of honesty. Growth often arrives with the discovery that a fair outcome sometimes requires an uncomfortable conversation first.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for September 29
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a September 29 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 22 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous September 29 birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 29 is the 272nd day of the year (273rd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Scorpio, is usually complete within 25 days, by October 24.

By September 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a September 29 birthday are Lech Wałęsa (1943), Enrico Fermi (1901) and Silvio Berlusconi (1936).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 29?
faq.answer: September 29 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Libra, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 29 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 22 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 29?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 29, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 29?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on September 29 include Lech Wałęsa (1943), Enrico Fermi (1901) and Silvio Berlusconi (1936). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
